comments.content:
Why is that.

I mean maybe it's better this way because nobody would ever cut the cameras..
I think they should continue to -not- require power.

Yeah the AI already fairly helpless and basically every game ends up in a dark and
powerless station.

Cutting the cameras (blinding the AI) is important, though I think killing all
cameras due to power failure wouldn't be any fun (AI can't really control it and it
completely owns the AI when it happens). Maybe if we ever get to a dynamic power
grid, we could look into it as forcing choices on the AI later (I only have a 2KW of
energy to spend - enough to power a camera up to 10s every 15s) or some such (without
making it tedious).
WontFix: requires extensive power grid overhaul with little (current) benefit
